PRODUCTION THINKING

Built beyond the happy path

The workflow makes failures visible, prevents duplicate actions and keeps humans in control.

01

Idempotency

Webhook keys stop duplicate CRM updates, messages and owner tasks.

02

Retry policy

Transient API failures retry with exponential backoff before escalation.

03

Dead-letter queue

Unresolved events are preserved with payload, reason and replay controls.

04

Human review

Ambiguous scores are routed to an owner instead of forcing a risky action.

SYSTEM DESIGN

Integration architecture

Vendor-neutral logic that can be implemented in n8n, Make, Zapier or a custom API service.
